svg.title: Legacy CANOE transportation model
svg.desc: Left-to-right legacy energy supply, vehicle families and transport service demands. Gold denotes imported fuels, blue technologies, green electricity or hydrogen, coral services and orange emissions accounting. The companion matrix specifies eligible fuels.

g.text: Embedded energy supply, transport technology families and end-use services
Supply chain, combustion and SMR + CCS
Energy routes are grouped by eligibility; the companion matrix specifies carrier-to-mode links.
Technology: capacity, efficiency, lifetime and costs. Fuel: prices, blend shares and fuel-cycle factors.
